description: Na₄MgCr₂O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and four longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.47 Å) and two longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-63°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.78 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom.
